newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal July inflation seen 0.1 pct - BSNP.
newsitem.headline: Portugal July inflation seen 0.1 pct - BSNP.

text.p: Portugal's Consumer Price Index is expected to have risen by 0.1 percent in July, putting year-on-year inflation at 1.8 percent and average annual inflation at 2.7 percent, Banco Santander de Negocios Portugal said.
In June inflation fell 0.3 percent, year-on-year inflation was 1.8 percent and average annual inflation 2.9 pct.

"The July consumer price index is expected to be announced between August 12 and 14, and should reveal a steady year-on-year rate and a clear deceleration in the average annual rate," BSNP said in a statement.
It also forecast a continued decrease in the average annual inflation rate in the coming months.

"In the coming months we expect a continued drop in the average annual inflation rate, which is expected to drop to 2.5 percent in August and to 2.4 percent in September, reaching 2.3 percent in December," it said.
